verdict.rationale: Riveter's evidence shows throttling exists, since the SDKs retry on 429 responses, but no document states a numeric per-key limit in requests per second or minute. The 10,000-rows-per-request cap limits batch size, not request rate, so it does not answer this story.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in

citations.quote: the SDKs handle auth, retries (429s and transient GET failures)
